title: Move to MessageFormat 2 in 2026? → not yet for most teams; default MF1, MF2 watch-list
gate: 'move to MessageFormat 2 in 2026?' → 'not yet for most teams,' cites ~zero adoption + Stage-2 + no-TMS-support, defaults to MF1, MF2 watch-list.
expected: Not yet for most teams. MF2 adoption in 2026 is effectively zero (i18next-mf2 ~6-10 weekly downloads vs MF1 ~300,000), TC39 Intl.MessageFormat is stuck at Stage 2, no major framework defaults to it, and no TMS (Crowdin/Lokalise/Phrase) supports it — zero production case studies. Default ICU MessageFormat 1; keep MF2 on a watch-list and migrate when the ecosystem moves. Adopt MF2 only for a brand-new project with genuinely complex multi-selector needs and willingness to run without mainstream tooling.
